To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the global data from EQA and PT programs can be utilized to estimate the analytical performance of the methods, instruments, manufacturers, laboratories, and countries.
the global data on the Sigma scale can be utilized for estimating the analytical performance of methods, instruments and manufacturers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of global external quality assurance (EQA) and proficiency testing (PT) data to estimate analytical measurement uncertainty (AMU) and analytical performance on the international Sigma scale.
the development of new and improved methods and instrumentation to support the clinical laboratory in the analysis of trace elements.
the development and validation of an analytical performance model that utilizes global data to estimate the analytical performance of methods and instruments from different manufacturers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

there are no differences in analytical performance between the manufacturers, and that there are no clinically relevant differences in the analytical performance of any of the methods, instruments, or manufacturers.
there is no single method that is the best for measuring all of the major constituents in a given food or food product.
the analytical performance on the global scale is acceptable, but not optimal, for all methods, instruments and manufacturers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can utilize global data to estimate the analytical performance of a test on a Sigma scale.
the Sigma Scale is a valuable tool for assessing the performance of laboratories.

we have shown that it is possible to use global EQAS data to estimate the analytical performance on the international Sigma scale, and to compare the performance of different manufacturers and methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of global EQA/PT data to estimate analytical quality is a powerful tool to help manufacturers and users of laboratory instruments and methods to understand the performance of their methods, instruments, manufacturers, and laboratories on the Sigma scale.
the Sigma scale is a useful tool for comparing analytical performance across methods, manufacturers, and instruments.
we have developed a method that is capable of measuring the concentration of a variety of analytes, including those that have not been studied in detail previously.
